derivation: from H4264 (מַחֲנֶה) and H1835 (דָּן); camp of Dan;

occurrences.text: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath–jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh–dan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjath–jearim.
